development_device: Nothing Phone (3) / Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 / Nothing OS 4.1
notes: Beta 4 is the frozen public release of the validated B30 baseline. It adds the expanded SYNTH and CHORDS engines, independent DRONE operation, extended decay ranges, HH OFF/8TH/4/4 modes, LFO volume destinations, refined mixer behavior and the restored BUS filter with RES GAIN.
